notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
[b] GOOD NEWS! [/b]

We want to thank everyone, who gave feedback on Ludwig. We appreciate and value your feedback! Therefore, we´re happy to announce, that a new version of Ludwig is available on Steam!

[b] Features: [/b]
[list]
     [*] [b] Login removed [/b]
[i]There is no need anymore, to create a separated Ludwig account and you don´t have to log in to play the game. No online DRM anymore. Yeah![/i]
     [*] [b] Language selection added [/b]
[i]There is a new section in the settings menu, which allows you, to change the language of the game. Please note, that you have to restart the game for the language change to take effect.[/i]
     [*] [b] Japanese language version added [/b]
[i]Say ハロー to our japanese friends![/i]
[/list] 

We hope, you like the new features 
Thank you for supporting Ludwig!
